title: CodeTime
description:
CodeTime is a minimalist and stylish interactive wallpaper for Wallpaper Engine that transforms your workspace into a digital developer environment. The clock is designed as a code snippet, displaying the current date, day of the week, time, and daily progress percentage.

It features animated clock hands and real-time data updates, creating the effect of a live programming interface. Perfect for developers, programmers, and tech enthusiasts!

Features:
✅ Minimalist design with a coding aesthetic
✅ Live clock styled as a JavaScript object
✅ Animated clock hands and smooth transitions
✅ Supports both 12-hour and 24-hour formats
✅ Lightweight and non-intrusive interface

You can check out my other works here:
https://steamcommunity.com/id/timaskg/myworkshopfiles/

If you want to deposit some money, here is my steam login: timas_kgzz

Clock format:
- Year: y (the last two characters will be displayed when only 2 digits are entered)
 - Month: M
 - Day: d
 - Hour (12-hour format): h
 - Hour (24-hour format): H
 - Minutes: m
 - Seconds: s
 - Line feed: \n
and two useless ones. 
 - Quarter: q
 - Milliseconds: S
If there are multiple digits, please enter the corresponding number of characters in succession, e.g. yyyy/MM/dd\nHH:mm:ss
Characters that do not match the above rule will be output as is

Setting the animation FPS to "Auto" will generally result in better animation, but may also result in inconsistent animation speed or smoothness in some rare cases. If you want a more consistent animation, please manually specify a fixed animation FPS in the wallpaper properties, and note that setting the animation FPS higher than the actual FPS of the wallpaper will result in slower animation speeds.
